# HVdilep_Zp500_piD5_ee

**AIDA-Scout S2 (dark shower to soft dileptons)** -- generated by `make_signal_cards.py`.

A Hidden Valley Z' of 500 GeV decays to a pair of dark quarks, which shower and hadronise in the hidden sector into dark mesons of mass 5 GeV (vectors at 10 GeV). Every decaying dark meson is forced to **e+e-**, giving a handful of soft, collimated leptons of a single flavour.

This point is one half of the matched ee/mumu pair: its partner is `HVdilep_Zp500_piD5_mumu`, which is **identical in every respect except the lepton flavour**.

## Configuration

* Hard process: `HiddenValley:ffbar2Zv`, m_Zp = 500 GeV
* Shower: `alphaOrder = 1`, `pTminFSR = 1.1 x Lambda` (specification default)
* Lambda = 5 GeV, Ngauge = 3, nFlav = 2, probVector = 0.75
* m_piD = 5 GeV, m_rhoD = 10 GeV, m_qv = 5 GeV
* Dark meson decays: 100% -> e+e-
* Cross section: **5.237 pb** (Pythia LO, no k-factor)

## Why it evades (or does not evade) the Phase-2 L1 menu

| Seed | Threshold | Fires? |
|---|---|---|
| PuppiHT | 450 (constituents pT > 30) | see caveat below |
| SinglePuppiJet | 230 | see caveat below |
| QuadJet | 400,70,55,40,40 | no |
| DoubleTkMuon (BPH) | 2,2, abs(eta)<1.5, dR<1.4, OS, dz<1cm | no muons -> N/A |
| DoubleTkMuon (central) | 4,4 | N/A |
| DoubleTkElectron | 25,12 | **no** (leptons far below 25,12) |
| DoubleTkIsoPhoton | 22,12 | no |
| DoublePuppiTau | 52,52 | no |
| PuppiETmiss | 200 | no |


## Caveats specific to this chain

* **No external Hidden Valley UFO is used.** The hard process is Pythia's own
  `HiddenValley:ffbar2Zv`, so the 4900xxx identity conventions of the hard
  process and of the shower are guaranteed to agree. This resolves open item 3
  of the specification: there is no UFO/module mismatch to check.
* **`nFlav = 2` leaves roughly half the dark shower invisible.** The
  off-diagonal dark mesons `4900211` / `4900213` carry a conserved dark flavour
  and have empty decay tables; they are marked stable explicitly. Measured on a
  50-event test at m_Zp = 500 / m_piD = 2: 5.4 decaying vs 5.2 stable dark
  mesons per event. This is identical between the ee and mumu samples, so the
  controlled comparison is unaffected.
* **The vectors are forced too.** With `probVector = 0.75` three quarters of the
  dark mesons are `rhov`. The specification fragment pins only `4900111`, which
  would have left most of the visible energy on the default flavour-democratic
  table and destroyed the ee/mumu contrast. `4900113` and `4900223` are
  therefore forced to the same channel. **This is an extension of the
  specification fragment, flagged here as requested.**
* **No MLM matching**, per specification section 4. The hard process is the
  resonance only; the shower supplies all extra radiation.

## Measured behaviour (50-event test, PU 200, m_Zp = 500 / m_piD = 2, mumu)

Reconstructed with the repo's Delphes L1T view:

* L1T PUPPI candidates: **~6700 per event**
* Leading L1T PUPPI jet pT: median **123 GeV**, 90th percentile **213 GeV**, max **241 GeV**
* HT over PUPPI jets above 30 GeV: median **195 GeV**, 90th percentile **377 GeV**, max **470 GeV**
* L1T muons: **4.7 per event**, median pT 20.7 GeV; **78% of events have two muons
  above 2 GeV within abs(eta) < 1.5**

Measured seed fire rates (50 events each, PU 200):

| Seed | ee | mumu |
|---|---|---|
| PuppiHT 450 | 0.04 | 0.04 |
| SinglePuppiJet 230 | 0.04 | 0.02 |
| DoubleTkMuon 2,2 | 0.00 | **0.78** |
| DoubleTkMuon 4,4 | 0.00 | **0.90** |
| DoubleTkElectron 25,12 | **0.58** | 0.00 |
| PuppiETmiss 200 | 0.06 | 0.04 |

## THE ee SAMPLE IS NOT UNCOVERED AT THIS BENCHMARK POINT

`DoubleTkElectron 25,12` fires in **58%** of ee events. The premise of S2 is that
soft di-electrons have no seed below 12 GeV, but at m_Zp = 500 GeV the electrons
are not soft: median reconstructed pT is 27.8 GeV, far above the floor. **As
configured, this point does not demonstrate the gap it was designed to
demonstrate.**

Root cause: the dark meson multiplicity is too low. Only ~5-6 decaying dark
mesons share the whole event, so each carries ~50 GeV and its two leptons ~25 GeV
each.

**Lambda is not the lever.** A scan over Lambda = 0.5, 1, 2 GeV changes the dark
meson multiplicity by less than 10% (4.0 -> 5.8 mesons/event). The reason is the
specification's own `pTminFSR = 1.1 x Lambda` rule: it ties the shower cutoff to
Lambda, so lowering Lambda lowers the cutoff by the same factor and the amount of
hidden-sector radiation barely moves.

**`HiddenValley:alphaFSR` is the lever.** Decoupling the cutoff from Lambda
(`alphaOrder = 0`, fixed `alphaFSR`, `pTminFSR = 0.5`) at m_Zp = 500 GeV gives:

| alphaFSR | dark mesons | leptons | median lepton pT | DoubleTkEle 25,12 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| (nominal, alphaOrder=1) | 5.8 | 10.9 | 5.0 GeV | 0.73 |
| 0.5 | 11.3 | 20.8 | 4.0 GeV | 0.69 |
| 0.8 | 14.3 | 25.9 | 3.4 GeV | 0.59 |
| 1.2 | 17.4 | 31.1 | 3.1 GeV | **0.49** |

Even at alphaFSR = 1.2 the fire rate is only halved, because the hard tail
survives. Lowering m_Zp is the complementary lever: at m_Zp = 200 GeV the
nominal configuration already drops to 0.36.

**Recommendation, for a decision rather than a silent change:** the cards as
shipped follow the specification (`alphaOrder = 1`, `pTminFSR = 1.1 x Lambda`,
m_Zp = 500/1000). To make the ee sample genuinely uncovered, they need
`alphaOrder = 0` with `alphaFSR` around 1 **and** a lower m_Zp (200-300 GeV).
That is a change to the specification's benchmark points, so it was not applied
unilaterally.

**Second caveat.** Because every dark meson decays to a lepton pair, the leptons
themselves cluster into PUPPI jets. At m_Zp = 500 GeV this produces ~120 GeV jets
and an HT tail reaching 470 GeV. The hadronic seeds fire at only ~4%, so this is
not currently the dominant problem, but it should be re-checked at any new
parameter point.

## Running

```bash
apptainer exec --bind $simdir \
  /cvmfs/unpacked.cern.ch/registry.hub.docker.com/jmduarte/mapyde:latest \
  sh $simdir/run.sh HVdilep_Zp500_piD5_ee <nevents> <seed> $simdir False
```

This point uses the **pythia** branch of `run.sh`.
